privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.subtitle: Base text in accordance with the Mexican Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (LFPDPPP). It does not replace legal advice: have your lawyer review it before using it in production. This English version is a courtesy translation; the Spanish version prevails.

s1.title: 1. Data controller
s1.body: , located at {address}, is responsible for the processing of your personal data in accordance with this privacy notice.

s2.title: 2. Personal data we collect
s2.body: We collect your name and phone number when you provide them voluntarily through the contact form or the "I'm interested" button of {name}. We do not collect sensitive personal data.

s3.title: 3. Purposes of the processing
s3.primary: Primary purposes, necessary to handle your request:
s3.primary1: To contact you to follow up on your interest in a unit at {name}.
s3.primary2: To share information, quotes and availability of the units in the development.
s3.secondary: Secondary purposes, which you may refuse without affecting how your request is handled:
s3.secondary1: To send you promotions and news about the development.

s4.title: 4. Data transfers
s4.body: We do not transfer your personal data to third parties, unless a competent authority requires it in accordance with the law.

s5.title: 5. ARCO rights
s5.body: You have the right to Access, Rectify and Cancel your personal data, as well as to Object to its processing (ARCO rights), and to withdraw your consent at any time. To exercise them, write to us at

s6.title: 6. Changes to this privacy notice
s6.body: Any change to this privacy notice will be published on this same page.
